messages:
Jordan (partnerships): FYI — SI partner wants SOC2 summary + HSM attestation before we do the joint marketplace announcement. Can we map owners and a short timeline? cc @Riley :eyes:

Riley (security): Ok. Required artifacts from marketplace: SOC2 report (PDF), executive summary, pen-test executive summary (not full vuln list), HSM vendor attestation letter, KMS/HSM architecture diagram, and screenshots showing key isolation + rotation policy. Also need a redaction plan for any PII in artifacts.

Sandeep (eng-security): I can produce the KMS/HSM architecture diagram and a short config proofset. For presigned delivery we should use a single S3 prefix per partner with TTL and object-level metadata indicating redaction status. Example presign command:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/si-acme/attest-2026-02-15.zip --expires-in 604800
``` That one-week TTL is fine for reviewers. Also propose we run our redaction script and include a manifest.json that lists original->redacted mapping (redacted fields removed, not stored).

Sam (si-partner): We can get the HSM vendor attestation next Tue (vendor confirms attestation wording). Confirming: the marketplace needs the attestation to state HSM model, FIPS level, and whether keys are customer-managed? Also we can provide encryption-at-rest proof (screencaps + logs).

Diana (cloud-partner): Marketplace listing team wants a single zipped bundle + index.csv that lists artifact filename, type (SOC2/pen/HSM/diagram), owner, and contact. They prefer 1 zip to simplify ingest. Also beware of their retention rules — they ask evidence be available for 30 days after submission for the listing review. I’ll open the listing intake ticket once we have the zip.

Riley (security): Owners proposal: security -> verify SOC2 exec summary + pen-test exec; eng-security -> HSM diagrams & config proofs; partnerships -> coordinate SI/vendor contact and announcement timing; platform (devops) -> create S3 prefix, presigned links, retention policy. I'll take SOC2/pen verification and quick redaction pass.

Jordan (partnerships): Timeline suggestion: artifacts staged by 2026-02-20 so marketplace team can review by 2026-02-25, announcement earliest 2026-03-03. Can everyone confirm owners and blockers by EOD Friday? :calendar: :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: A listing intake ticket has been created: MP-4872. Intake checklist added to the ticket. Confluence draft for the joint announcement: https://redwood.internal/confluence/mp-announcements/si-acme (permissions: partnerships + security + eng-security).

Sam (si-partner): Got it — will upload vendor attestation + encryption screenshots to the presign prefix once Jordan confirms the final S3 path. We might need a short NDA excerpt attached for the vendor attestation (they prefer limited distribution).

Sandeep (eng-security): Quick note on redaction: our script strips emails, IPs, and account IDs and produces a redaction-log.txt that we include in the zip. If vendor wants more aggressive redaction, say now.

Jordan (partnerships): Perfect. Action items: Riley (SOC/pen verify), Sandeep (HSM/artifact manifest + run redaction), Diana (open intake + confirm retention policy), Sam (vendor attestation upload), Jordan (coordinate announcement schedule + final zip). Back here Friday with confirmations. :v:
